selected_passages.text:
TUITION FEE: Partner Universities: FREE. Non-partner universities: Based on registered courses.
ADMINISTRATION FEE: $70, to be submitted after students arrive at TUAF.
VISA FEE: $95.00/6 Months (1 semester); $135.00/12 Months (2 semester).
INSURANCE FEE: Students should purchase travel insurance in their home country.
ESTIMATED COST OF LIVING: Accommodation: $10 (Dormitory). Food: $90-110/month ($1-1.3/meal). Bills (Electricity, water, cleaning, etc.): $7-15/month.
selected_passages.note_zh: 逐行視讀p2；原生排序失真，不混用。原頁僅$，住宿未標週期；非當期116。

page_notes_zh: 秋8/15–12/30春1/15–6/10年例。提名秋7/15春11/15；Acceptance段7/25／11/25，不武斷當学生申请截止。提名後給網申，收到完整application附件才發offer。申請表+7件：ToR、Englishproof、學生證、motivationbriefshorttermplan、recommendation、passport、localhospitalhealthcheck英譯。完整表內容另已讀，證明optional矛盾先保留。

原生抽取fee順序錯：**視讀實際行政$70到校後，Visa$95/6month/$135/12month**，不是行政95簽證70。原頁只有$無USD明文，幣別未知；partner免tuition/nonpartner依course不等全免。travelinsurance母國買。Dorm$10無週期，food$90–110/month單餐1–1.3，bills7–15/month。不能把別手冊的月週期自動填此原頁或任意合總價。Fliphtmlhandbook入口不代表已讀全冊。校景及人物照片無重用授權。

selected_passages.text: Aug, 2026. Submission of Nomination Sheet (by email): August 21 – September 11, 2026, submitted by 24:00 Japan time. Submission of application documents (by online): September 25 – October 16, 2026, submitted by 24:00 Japan time. We do not accept any materials sent by a student. All participants must return to their Home University after completing the programs at UF, and continue their studies to get a degree at their Home University.
selected_passages.note_zh: Spring2027承辦人流程，不是中央116；提名email與其他原件指定入口差異保留。

selected_passages.text: Eligible exchange students will receive a monthly scholarship of 80,000 JPY. The result and detailed scholarship information for the currently-recruiting exchange programs will be available in February 2027. To apply for the JASSO scholarship, exchange students must have earned, in principle, a grade point average (designated by JASSO, refer to page 3) of at least 2.30 on a 3.0-scale in the previous academic year.
selected_passages.note_zh: 獎學金不是普遍錄取GPA或保證收入；實際PDF只有2頁，所引第3頁未取得。

page_notes_zh: 提名email2026/8/21–9/11 24:00JST，其他文件online9/25–10/16 24:00JST由母校，不收學生直接送；提名後寄系統指引，承辦先審全件最新版。錄取2026/12中、COE2027/2中、visa2–3月本人、分級線上3月初中、入住3/25/26、迎新3/29/30/31，可能調整非保證。每partner1–2接收限制是generic不是中央116配額。交換完必返母校續讀，交換中不能自母校畢業/拿degree。SpecialAuditing成績春通常10末、秋4末；提早要正式request信，最早春9末秋4初，非學生email保證提前。
接p1最早春9末秋4初。JASSO80000JPY/month合格者但結果Feb2027後，前年JASSO2.30/3.0以上原則；這是獎學金不是一般交換GPA，寫referpage3但原PDF只有2頁，未捏造formula。健康有疑先與學生商談再母校聯絡，緊急交換所需資訊合作非要全體公开病歷。

page_notes_zh: 三年工程cycle示意是嵌圖：preparatory2–3yr+nationalexam，ENSEAyear1basicelectronics/electrical/CStelecommathsignal及1–2月intern，year2majorsCS/electronics/automation/signal及3–4月intern，year3specializations及6月finalintern，endMasterlevelEngineer。這是一般學制不是每名交換都需考nationalentrance或保證拿碩士；不用原生沒抽到圖就稱全頁空白。

秋nonEU提名5/15學生6/1，EU6/1學生6/15；春10/15、10/31。母校Excel提名email，最新template須向IO索取。FrenchB1certEnglishB2cert，英授在ENSEA2/3yearMasterlevel；全英不需法語程度證明但全期法語課mandatory。秋9–1中、補考3中possibleonline不保證；春1–4中+若需intern到8月。VLS-TS及幾週辦理是校方指引非當期法律判斷。房租300–800EUR/month，多數可校方協助附近residence，有限firstcome、首次赴法優先非保證。
校表籠統稱2026/7非European無住房補助，既有已讀政府host-fr-housing列多種例外，保留政府優先差異不重寫成全面禁止；不把補助列保證收入。特殊支援須提前告知；Bienvenue3star2024標章非學位ranking或當期申請核准。
